AI-Written Stories Are Landing on Reddit, and the Fix Is Checking the Platform Yourself

In this issue

  • What I Tell People to Do About It. I would encourage people to filter down and do the research you need to do.
  • What Checking Your Platform Looks Like. I did the slow version on two platforms I like.
  • Platforms I Have Already Written About. I chose Shopware and SCAYLE because Dunphy's post mentioned them, and I added BigCommerce and Shopify because I wanted a few more.
